(()=>{const s=window.__qaProvider;if(!s||s.error)throw Error('Provider probe failed: '+JSON.stringify(s));if(!s.available)throw Error('Provider unavailable');if(s.model!=='MiniMax-M3')throw Error('Wrong model: '+s.model);return JSON.stringify({provider:s.provider,model:s.model})})()
(()=>{const s=window.__qaSeed;if(!s)throw Error('Seed never resolved');if(!s.ok)throw Error('Seed failed: '+s.error);return JSON.stringify(s)})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('textarea[placeholder^="Ask anything"]'))return 'already-open';const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Live assistant');if(!b)throw Error('No Live assistant launcher');b.click();return 'opened'})()

(()=>{window.__qaEmpty=null;const END=Date.now()+90000;const tick=async()=>{try{const r=await (async()=>{const h=await import('/src/studio/assistant/chatHistory.ts');const a=await h.readChatArchive(window.__qaJob);const t=(a?.threads??[]).find(x=>x.id===a?.activeId)??(a?.threads??[]).at(-1);return {projectId:a?.projectId??null,activeId:a?.activeId??null,entries:(t?.entries??[]).length}})();if(r.entries===0){window.__qaEmpty={ok:true,...r};return}if(Date.now()>=END){window.__qaEmpty={ok:false,timeout:true,...r};return}setTimeout(tick,2000)}catch(e){window.__qaEmpty={ok:false,reason:String(e)}}};tick();return 'checking-empty'})()
(()=>{const f=window.__qaEmpty;if(!f.ok)throw Error('Conversation was not empty before the turn: '+JSON.stringify(f));return JSON.stringify({conversationEmptyBeforeTurn:true,...f})})()

(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('textarea[placeholder^="Ask anything"]');if(!t)throw Error('No composer');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set.call(t,"For the restart check: the north elevation reopens at 2400 mm. Reference RSTRT-21-A7.");t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return 'composed ' + t.value.length + ' chars'})()
